items.title: From Healthcare Data to Actionable Intelligence: An Integrative Review and Gated Framework for Trustworthy Al-Enabled Healthcare Analytics
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: The increasing availability of electronic health records, clinical narratives, biomedical literature, imaging, physiological signals, and patient-generated data has created substantial opportunities for artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled healthcare analytics. Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and large language models (LLMs) can extract, summarize, synthesize, and transform heterogeneous healthcare information. However, AI-generated information does not automatically constitute reliable or actionable intelligence. Data quality, interoperability, provenance, hallucination, bias, validation, human oversight, workflow integration, and governance may disrupt the transition from healthcare data to responsible action. Main body: This integrative review synthesizes recent literature addressing the transformation of heterogeneous healthcare data through AI-enabled analytics and identifies conditions required for reliable and actionable use. A structured literature search was conducted, followed by title and abstract screening and targeted full-text assessment of relevant evidence. Data were organized using a predefined extraction framework covering data characteristics, AI applications, interoperability, provenance, validation, privacy, human oversight, workflow integration, governance, and outcomes. Evidence was synthesized thematically across the healthcare data-to-action pathway. The synthesis identified four interconnected requirements: data readiness, evidence traceability, output reliability, and action readiness. These requirements were integrated into the proposed Data-to-Actionable-Intelligence (D2AI) Gated Framework. The framework conceptualizes healthcare AI as a sequential pathway in which data must first be fit for purpose, generated information must remain traceable to relevant evidence, outputs must undergo task-appropriate validation, and validated insights must be integrated into accountable human workflows before they can become actionable intelligence. Short conclusion: AI-generated output should not be considered actionable intelligence by default. The D2AI framework provides a health-informatics-oriented model that connects data quality, AI transformation, evidence traceability, validation, human oversight, workflow integration, and governance. It complements existing multidimensional AI evaluation frameworks by emphasizing the sequential conditions required for healthcare information to progress from heterogeneous data to accountable action. AI, artificial intelligence; D2AI, Data-to-Actionable-Intelligence; EHR, electronic health record; FAIR, findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable; FHIR, Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources; GenAI, generative artificial intelligence; LLM, large language model; RAG, retrieval-augmented generation.
items.summary_zh: 整合性综述提出 D2AI 门控框架，将医疗数据转化为可负责行动智能的过程划分为数据就绪、证据可追溯、输出可靠和行动就绪四个连续要求。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作明确提醒，AI 输出本身不等于可行动的临床智能；框架可用于设计医疗 AI 的验证、人工监督、工作流整合与治理流程。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：电子健康记录、临床叙述、生物医学文献、影像、生理信号和患者生成数据日益丰富，为人工智能（AI）医疗分析创造了重要机会。生成式人工智能（GenAI）和大型语言模型（LLM）能够提取、总结、综合并转换异质医疗信息。然而，AI 生成的信息并不会自动成为可靠或可行动的智能。数据质量、互操作性、来源追踪、幻觉、偏倚、验证、人工监督、工作流整合和治理，都可能阻碍医疗数据向负责任行动的转变。主体内容：本整合性综述综合了关于通过 AI 分析转换异质医疗数据的近期文献，并确定实现可靠且可行动使用所需的条件。研究开展了结构化文献检索，随后进行题名和摘要筛选，并对相关证据开展有针对性的全文评估。数据按照预先定义的提取框架组织，涵盖数据特征、AI 应用、互操作性、来源追踪、验证、隐私、人工监督、工作流整合、治理和结局。研究沿医疗数据到行动路径对证据进行了主题综合。综合结果确定了四项相互关联的要求：数据就绪、证据可追溯、输出可靠和行动就绪。这些要求被整合进拟议的“数据到可行动智能”（D2AI）门控框架。该框架将医疗 AI 概念化为一条连续路径：数据首先必须适合其用途，生成的信息必须保持对相关证据的可追溯性，输出必须经过与任务相匹配的验证，经过验证的洞见随后必须整合进由人负责的工作流，才能成为可行动智能。简短结论：默认情况下，不应把 AI 生成的输出视为可行动智能。D2AI 框架提供了一个面向健康信息学的模型，连接数据质量、AI 转换、证据可追溯性、验证、人工监督、工作流整合和治理。它通过强调医疗信息从异质数据走向可负责行动所需的连续条件，补充了现有的多维 AI 评估框架。AI，人工智能；D2AI，Data-to-Actionable-Intelligence；EHR，electronic health record；FAIR，findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable；FHIR，Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources；GenAI，generative artificial intelligence；LLM，large language model；RAG，retrieval-augmented generation。

items.title: General-Purpose Vision Models to Dermatology-Specific Foundation Models: Comparative Evaluation for Facial Skin Disease Classification
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Skin diseases represent a major global health burden, while access to dermatological expertise remains limited in many rural and resource-constrained settings. These disparities have increased interest in scalable digital tools for dermatological assessment and patient education. However, trustworthy clinical AI requires reproducible evaluation, standardized benchmarking, transparent reporting of failure patterns, and assessment of model robustness across different representations and classification strategies. This study presents a systematic transfer-learning framework for six-class facial skin disease classification, comparing seven pretrained visual representations comprising ResNet50, MobileNetV3-Large, ViT-B/16, Swin-T, DINOv2, DermLIP and Derm Foundation, under a common downstream classification framework. XGBoost was used as the primary downstream classifier, while an RBF-kernel support vector machine (SVM) was additionally evaluated as an ablation analysis to investigate the dependence of classification performance on downstream classifier selection. Performance was assessed using accuracy, macro-F1, macro-AUROC, per-class recall, confusion matrices, and bootstrap-derived 95% confidence intervals, with paired McNemar testing and Holm correction used to compare classifier. Derm Foundation achieved the highest performance among the evaluated feature representations when combined with XGBoost, obtaining 88.17% accuracy, 88.05% macro-F1, and 98.58% macro-AUROC on the testing set. At the class level, recall was 94.5% for acne, 87.0% for atopic dermatitis, 100.0% for normal skin, 90.5% for psoriasis, 84.0% for rosacea, and 73.0% for seborrheic dermatitis. Classifier comparisons showed that the relative performance of XGBoost and RBF-SVM depended on the underlying feature representation. The principal residual classification difficulty involved seborrheic dermatitis, particularly its reciprocal confusion with rosacea. To demonstrate technical feasibility, the classification framework was integrated into a prototype Django-based web application architecture featuring an exploratory LLM module for automated patient-education content translation. Preliminary, descriptive specialist feedback was gathered to identify future engineering optimization constraints, such as inference latency and communication mechanics. These findings are limited to the evaluated testing dataset and do not establish external generalizability or clinical efficacy.
items.summary_zh: 在统一下游分类框架下比较 7 种视觉表征用于 6 类面部皮肤病分类，Derm Foundation 与 XGBoost 组合在测试集达到 88.17% accuracy、88.05% macro-F1 和 98.58% macro-AUROC。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究同时报告类别级召回、置信区间、McNemar 检验和分类器消融，显示皮肤病 AI 的性能依赖表征与下游分类器，且结果尚不能证明外部泛化或临床有效性。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 皮肤病构成重大全球健康负担，而许多农村和资源受限地区获得皮肤科专业知识的机会有限。这些差距推动了可扩展数字工具在皮肤科评估和患者教育中的发展。然而，可信的临床 AI 需要可复现评估、标准化基准测试、透明的失败模式报告，以及对不同表征和分类策略下模型稳健性的评估。本研究提出了一个用于 6 类面部皮肤病分类的系统迁移学习框架，在统一的下游分类框架下比较 7 种预训练视觉表征：ResNet50、MobileNetV3-Large、ViT-B/16、Swin-T、DINOv2、DermLIP 和 Derm Foundation。XGBoost 被用作主要下游分类器，同时使用 RBF-kernel support vector machine（SVM）进行额外消融分析，以考察分类性能对下游分类器选择的依赖。研究使用 accuracy、macro-F1、macro-AUROC、各类别 recall、混淆矩阵和 bootstrap 得到的 95% 置信区间评估性能，并采用配对 McNemar 检验和 Holm 校正比较分类器。Derm Foundation 与 XGBoost 组合时，在所评估的特征表征中表现最佳，在测试集上获得 88.17% accuracy、88.05% macro-F1 和 98.58% macro-AUROC。类别级 recall 分别为：acne 94.5%、atopic dermatitis 87.0%、normal skin 100.0%、psoriasis 90.5%、rosacea 84.0% 和 seborrheic dermatitis 73.0%。分类器比较显示，XGBoost 和 RBF-SVM 的相对性能取决于所使用的特征表征。主要残余分类困难涉及 seborrheic dermatitis，尤其是其与 rosacea 的相互混淆。为展示技术可行性，研究将该分类框架集成进一个基于 Django 的原型 Web 应用架构，并加入用于自动患者教育内容翻译的探索性 LLM 模块。研究还收集了初步的描述性专科人员反馈，以识别推理延迟和沟通机制等未来工程优化约束。这些结果仅限于所评估的测试数据集，不能证明外部泛化性或临床有效性。

items.title: Current Attitudes and Use Patterns of Large Language Models in Clinical Practice and Medical Education Among Trauma Providers
creators: The 2026 Design for Implementation (DFI) Authorship Group,
items.abstract_or_text: Introduction: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in clinical practice and medical education, yet uncertainty remains regarding appropriate use, oversight, and potential effects on clinical reasoning and patient safety. This study examined current LLM use patterns, attitudes, perceived risks, and priorities for responsible integration among individuals engaged in trauma care, clinical guidance development, and medical education. Methods: Participants attending the third Design for Implementation: The Future of Trauma Clinical Guidance and Research Conference (DFI) completed surveys examining LLM use, attitudes, perceived inhibitors to personal use, and clinical applications. During facilitated sessions, participants used open-ended note-taking guides to document their perspectives regarding LLM use in clinical practice, education, and guidance development. Survey data were analyzed descriptively, and qualitative responses were analyzed using rapid qualitative content analysis. Results: 77 participants completed the pre-conference survey; 62 clinicians provided data regarding clinical LLM use and attitudes. Among clinicians, 15% reported daily LLM use, whereas 26% reported never using LLMs. Respondents expressed strongest agreement with the need for regular quality auditing of LLM-supported clinical decisions. Among 52 post-conference survey respondents, 96% somewhat or strongly agreed that clinical training curricula should include education on LLM use. Barriers to LLM use included time required to verify accuracy, concern about patient harm, and insufficient training in appropriate prompting. Qualitative data came from 23 note-taking documents administered during the conference. Both positive and negative perspectives arose regarding AI use, centering on topics including efficiency gains, deskilling and never-skilling, governance and oversight, accuracy and hallucination, patient safety, and education. Discussion: DFI participants recognized efficiency and informational benefits of LLMs while identifying important concerns related to accuracy, patient safety, skill development, and governance. Findings support a need for institutional guidance, education in responsible LLM use, and evaluation of the incorporation of these technologies into clinical practice and health professions education.
items.summary_zh: 对创伤照护、临床指南制定和医学教育参与者调查 LLM 使用、态度与风险：62 名临床医生中 15% 每日使用，26% 从不使用；96% 的会后受访者支持将 LLM 教育纳入临床培训。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是对真实临床使用和治理需求的横断面证据，但样本来自会议参与者，不能外推到所有临床人员，也不能据此判断 LLM 对患者结局的因果影响。
items.abstract_zh: 引言：大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于临床实践和医学教育，但其适当用法、监督方式以及对临床推理和患者安全的潜在影响仍存在不确定性。本研究考察了参与创伤照护、临床指导制定和医学教育人员当前的 LLM 使用模式、态度、感知风险以及负责任整合的优先事项。方法：参加第三届“实施设计：创伤临床指导与研究的未来”会议（DFI）的参与者完成了关于 LLM 使用、态度、个人使用的感知障碍和临床应用的调查。在引导式会议期间，参与者使用开放式记录指南记录他们对 LLM 用于临床实践、教育和指导制定的看法。调查数据进行描述性分析，定性回答采用快速定性内容分析。结果：77 名参与者完成会前调查；62 名临床医生提供了临床 LLM 使用和态度数据。在临床医生中，15% 报告每天使用 LLM，而 26% 报告从未使用 LLM。受访者最强烈同意的观点是，需要定期审计 LLM 支持的临床决策质量。在 52 名会后调查受访者中，96% 对“临床培训课程应包括 LLM 使用教育”表示有些同意或强烈同意。使用 LLM 的障碍包括核查准确性所需时间、对患者伤害的担忧，以及缺乏适当提示方面的培训。定性数据来自会议期间收集的 23 份记录文件。参与者对 AI 的使用既有积极看法也有消极看法，核心主题包括效率提升、技能弱化和技能未形成、治理与监督、准确性与幻觉、患者安全以及教育。讨论：DFI 参与者认可 LLM 的效率和信息价值，同时指出准确性、患者安全、技能发展和治理方面的重要担忧。结果支持制定机构层面的指导方针、开展负责任的 LLM 使用教育，并评估这些技术在临床实践和卫生专业教育中的整合。

items.title: Crystalline silica exposure causes latent biomechanical abnormalities along the cardiopulmonary axis
items.abstract_or_text: Rationale Crystalline silica exposure is a major global health burden linked to chronic lung disease and cardiopulmonary morbidity, but early lung-vascular-cardiac abnormalities preceding overt functional decline are poorly defined. Objectives To determine whether a single crystalline silica exposure produces subclinical abnormalities across the integrated axis of cardiopulmonary response (lung[->]pulmonary artery[->]right ventricle) and identify associated sex-dependent physiologic patterns and molecular programs. Methods Male and female mice received a single endotracheal instillation of crystalline silica or vehicle (saline). At 28 days, assessments included voluntary wheel running, diffusion capacity, pulmonary function testing, bronchoalveolar lavage analysis, lung histology and electron microscopy, ex vivo proximal pulmonary artery biomechanics and microstructural second harmonic generation imaging, right ventricular pressure, transthoracic echocardiography, and bulk RNA sequencing of lung and right ventricle. Results Despite recovery of body weight and preserved voluntary exercise, silica-exposed mice demonstrated reduced diffusion capacity, ultrastructural thickening, and disruption of the alveolar-capillary barrier. Bronchoalveolar lavage revealed persistent inflammation with elevated macrophages, lymphocytes, neutrophils, and protein, alongside retained particulate and surfactant-rich debris (silicoproteinosis). Lung mechanics were sex-dependent; females showed a parenchymal-dominant phenotype and males showed increased airway resistance. Elevated pulmonary circulatory pressures caused increased functional stiffness and reduced distensibility of the proximal pulmonary arteries. Right ventricular free wall thickening was noted in females. Lung transcriptomics indicated persistent immune activation and extracellular matrix remodeling, while the right ventricle demonstrated metabolic reprogramming with downregulation of structural and reparative programs. Conclusions A single crystalline silica exposure induces a subclinical, multi-compartment cardiopulmonary phenotype characterized by persistent alveolar-capillary injury, pulmonary vascular stiffening, increased right ventricular afterload, sex-dependent pulmonary mechanics, and divergent organ-level transcriptomic responses.
items.summary_zh: 小鼠单次晶体二氧化硅暴露 28 天后，即使体重和自愿运动恢复，仍出现肺泡-毛细血管损伤、肺血管僵硬、右心室后负荷增加及性别依赖的转录组变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多器官力学、组织学、影像和 bulk RNA sequencing 联合揭示了明显功能下降前的亚临床心肺表型，但动物模型结果不能直接等同于人类病因或临床效应。
items.abstract_zh: 依据：晶体二氧化硅暴露是全球重大健康负担，与慢性肺病和心肺发病率相关，但明显功能下降之前的早期肺-血管-心脏异常仍定义不清。目的：确定单次晶体二氧化硅暴露是否会在整合的心肺反应轴（肺[->]肺动脉[->]右心室）上产生亚临床异常，并识别相关的性别依赖性生理模式和分子程序。方法：雄性和雌性小鼠接受单次晶体二氧化硅或载体（生理盐水）气管内滴注。第 28 天开展自发跑轮、弥散能力、肺功能检测、支气管肺泡灌洗分析、肺组织学和电子显微镜检查、离体近端肺动脉生物力学测试及微结构二次谐波生成成像、右心室压力测量、经胸超声心动图，以及肺和右心室的 bulk RNA sequencing。结果：尽管体重恢复且自愿运动保持不变，二氧化硅暴露小鼠仍表现出弥散能力下降、超微结构增厚以及肺泡-毛细血管屏障破坏。支气管肺泡灌洗显示持续性炎症，伴随巨噬细胞、淋巴细胞、中性粒细胞和蛋白升高，同时存在残留颗粒及富含表面活性物质的碎屑（硅蛋白沉积症）。肺力学表现具有性别依赖性；雌性表现为实质主导型表型，雄性表现为空气道阻力增加。肺循环压力升高导致近端肺动脉功能性僵硬增加和扩张性下降。雌性小鼠观察到右心室游离壁增厚。肺转录组显示持续的免疫激活和细胞外基质重塑，而右心室表现为代谢重编程，并下调结构和修复程序。结论：单次晶体二氧化硅暴露会诱导一种亚临床、多区室心肺表型，其特征包括持续性肺泡-毛细血管损伤、肺血管僵硬增加、右心室后负荷增加、性别依赖的肺力学，以及器官层面不同的转录组反应。

items.title: Beyond Better Models: Barriers and a Path Forward in Generalisable TCR Antigen Specificity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: T cells are at the centre of adaptive immunity, protecting the organism against infection and cancer. T cell receptors (TCRs), expressed on the surface of T cells, enable the recognition of target cells through interactions with peptides presented by major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) molecules. Reliable, large-scale mapping of TCRs to their cognate pMHCs remains a holy grail of modern systems immunology, with far-reaching implications for cancer immunotherapy, vaccine development, and the understanding and treatment of autoimmune diseases. While exhaustive experimental mapping remains intractable due to the enormous combinatorial sequence space of TCRs and pMHCs, computational approaches offer a promising alternative. Consequently, we have witnessed increasingly sophisticated computational models of TCR antigen specificity, from small neural networks to deep generative models and large protein language models. However, several independent benchmarks have shown that these models, despite their size and sophistication, largely fail to generalise to TCRs or pMHCs not present in the data available during model development. Here, we investigate possible reasons for this and suggest a path forward to generalisable TCR:pMHC prediction. First, our analysis of the largest public repositories of TCR:pMHC data reveals significant biases towards a small number of antigens and MHC molecules, sparse sampling of TCR sequence space per pMHC, as well as inconsistencies and inaccuracies in data collation. Second, we show the importance of carefully setting up model evaluation to measure discrimination based on antigen specificity instead of confounding factors present in the evaluation data. Finally, we highlight the need for and propose how best to match the evaluation metric with the specific downstream application of the predictions. Our investigation suggests that we, as a community, need more representative and better curated data, and a robust set of metrics and benchmarks to guide future model development towards generalisable TCR:pMHC specificity prediction.
items.summary_zh: 综述并分析 TCR:pMHC 特异性预测的泛化障碍，指出公共数据对少数抗原和 MHC 偏倚、TCR 序列空间采样稀疏及整理不一致，并提出匹配应用场景的评估基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把模型规模问题转化为数据代表性、去混杂评估和指标选择问题，对免疫治疗、疫苗和自身免疫研究中的 TCR 模型复现性具有直接意义。
items.abstract_zh: T 细胞处于适应性免疫的中心，通过保护机体抵抗感染和癌症发挥作用。表达于 T 细胞表面的 T 细胞受体（TCR）通过与主要组织相容性复合体呈递的肽（pMHC）相互作用，使 T 细胞能够识别靶细胞。可靠且大规模地将 TCR 映射到其同源 pMHC，是现代系统免疫学长期追求的目标，对癌症免疫治疗、疫苗开发以及自身免疫性疾病的理解和治疗具有深远意义。由于 TCR 与 pMHC 的组合序列空间极其庞大，穷尽式实验映射难以实现，因此计算方法提供了有前景的替代方案。相应地，TCR 抗原特异性计算模型日益复杂，从小型神经网络发展到深度生成模型和大型蛋白质语言模型。然而，多个独立基准已经表明，尽管这些模型规模更大、结构更复杂，它们在很大程度上仍无法泛化到模型开发数据中未出现的 TCR 或 pMHC。本文研究其可能原因，并提出实现可泛化 TCR:pMHC 预测的路径。首先，我们对最大的公共 TCR:pMHC 数据库进行分析，发现其明显偏向少数抗原和 MHC 分子；每种 pMHC 对应的 TCR 序列空间采样稀疏；数据汇编还存在不一致和不准确。其次，我们展示了精心设置模型评估的重要性：评估应测量基于抗原特异性的区分能力，而不是评估数据中混杂因素带来的区分能力。最后，我们强调并提出了将评估指标与预测的具体下游应用相匹配的最佳方法。我们的分析表明，整个领域需要更具代表性且整理更完善的数据，以及一套稳健的指标和基准，以指导未来模型开发，实现可泛化的 TCR:pMHC 特异性预测。

items.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence in Radiological Imaging: Bridging Computational Explanations and Radiological Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) is increasingly applied to radiological imaging to improve the transparency of artificial intelligence systems. However, the clinical usefulness of many XAI approaches remains uncertain because computational explanations are not always aligned with radiological reasoning, user requirements, workflow, or governance needs. This study aimed to map recent XAI research in radiological imaging, identify gaps in the clinical translation of explanations, and develop an integrative framework for clinically oriented XAI. A systematic scoping review was conducted following the Arksey and O’Malley framework and subsequent refinements, with reporting guided by PRISMA-ScR. MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and Embase via Ovid were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and June 2026. Eligible studies applied identifiable XAI approaches to radiological or clinically relevant medical imaging and reported information concerning explanations or their evaluation. Evidence was descriptively mapped and thematically synthesized according to XAI methods, clinical applications, explanation evaluation, clinical translation, usability, workflow integration, and governance. The evidence demonstrated substantial methodological diversity across imaging modalities, clinical tasks, AI architectures, and XAI approaches. This includes gradient-based, perturbation and feature-based, attention-based, prototype and concept-based, counterfactual, and inherently interpretable approaches. However, explanation evaluation was predominantly model-centered, with comparatively limited assessment of clinical understanding, relevance, usefulness, and integration into radiological decision-making. A recurring clinical translation gap was identified between computational outputs, such as heatmaps and feature-attribution representations, and the anatomical, morphological, and diagnostic concepts used in radiological reasoning. Workflow, usability, human oversight, and governance were also inconsistently integrated into XAI evaluation. These findings indicate that the principal challenge in radiological XAI is not the absence of explanation techniques but the lack of an integrated process for selecting, translating, evaluating, and documenting explanations according to clinical context. To address this gap, the Explainability–Radiology AI Integration (XRAI) Framework was developed, comprising six linked layers: clinical context profiling, XAI method selection, explanation generation, clinical translation, usability validation and feedback, and regulatory compliance logging. XRAI provides a conceptual and a transparent basis for connecting computational explainability with clinically meaningful and accountable radiological practice. Further empirical evaluation is required to establish its effectiveness across clinical tasks, imaging modalities, user groups, and deployment environments.
items.summary_zh: 系统综述 2020 年至 2026 年放射影像 XAI，发现解释评估主要围绕模型本身，临床理解、实用性、工作流和治理纳入不足，并提出六层 XRAI 框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把热图等计算解释与放射科实际的解剖、形态和诊断推理之间的落差明确化，但 XRAI 仍需跨任务、模态和用户实证验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 可解释人工智能（XAI）越来越多地应用于放射影像，以提高人工智能系统的透明度。然而，许多 XAI 方法的临床实用性仍不确定，因为计算解释不一定与放射科推理、用户需求、工作流或治理要求一致。本研究旨在绘制近期放射影像 XAI 研究图谱，识别解释临床转化中的缺口，并建立一个面向临床的整合框架。研究按照 Arksey 和 O’Malley 框架及其后续改进开展系统范围综述，报告遵循 PRISMA-ScR。研究检索了 MEDLINE/PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science Core Collection、IEEE Xplore、ACM Digital Library，以及通过 Ovid 检索的 Embase，纳入 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月发表的同行评议研究。符合条件的研究将可识别的 XAI 方法应用于放射影像或临床相关医学影像，并报告与解释或解释评估有关的信息。证据按照 XAI 方法、临床应用、解释评估、临床转化、可用性、工作流整合和治理进行描述性映射和主题综合。证据显示，不同影像模态、临床任务、AI 架构和 XAI 方法之间存在显著方法学多样性，包括基于梯度、扰动和特征的方法，基于注意力的方法，基于原型和概念的方法，反事实方法，以及内在可解释的方法。然而，解释评估主要以模型为中心，对临床理解、相关性、实用性以及与放射科决策整合的评估相对有限。研究反复发现一个临床转化缺口：热图和特征归因表示等计算输出，与放射科推理所使用的解剖、形态和诊断概念之间存在差距。工作流、可用性、人工监督和治理也未被一致纳入 XAI 评估。这些发现表明，放射影像 XAI 的主要挑战并不是缺少解释技术，而是缺少一个根据临床情境选择、转换、评估和记录解释的整合过程。为解决这一缺口，研究提出 Explainability–Radiology AI Integration（XRAI）框架，包括六个相互连接的层：临床情境画像、XAI 方法选择、解释生成、临床转换、可用性验证与反馈，以及法规合规记录。XRAI 为连接计算可解释性与具有临床意义且可负责的放射学实践提供了概念性和透明的基础。仍需进一步实证评估，以确定其在不同临床任务、影像模态、用户群体和部署环境中的有效性。

items.title: EEG Biomarkers for Rett Syndrome: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning with Explainable AI
items.abstract_or_text: Rett syndrome (RTT) is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by abnormal cortical activity, which can be captured using electroencephalography (EEG). Although machine learning (ML) has shown promise for diagnosing several neurological conditions, comprehensive evaluation of classical ML and deep learning (DL) methods, together with physiologically meaningful explanations, remains limited for RTT. This study analyses resting-state, eyes-closed EEG recordings from RTT patients and healthy controls using both power spectral density (PSD)-based ML and end-to-end DL frameworks. Classical ML models, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forest, and XGBoost, were trained on PSD features, while EEG-specific DL architectures, including ShallowConvNet, DeepConvNet, EEGNet, and EEG Conformer, were trained directly on preprocessed EEG signals. Subject-wise cross-validation was used to avoid data leakage, with balanced accuracy as the primary performance metric because it equally accounts for sensitivity and specificity. Random Forest achieved the best performance among the classical ML models, whereas EEGNet achieved the highest DL performance. An ablation study indicated that 4-second EEG epochs offered the optimal trade-off between model performance and robustness. Model interpretability was investigated using SHAP for Random Forest and occlusion sensitivity analysis for EEGNet. Both methods consistently identified delta and theta oscillations, along with centro-frontal brain regions, as key contributors to RTT classification. These findings show that both PSD-based machine learning and end-to-end deep learning methods can reliably identify RTT and highlight common neurophysiological biomarkers, offering an interpretable framework for EEG-based diagnosis and biomarker discovery for Rett Syndrome.
items.summary_zh: 比较 PSD 特征机器学习与端到端深度学习识别 Rett syndrome，并以 subject-wise cross-validation 防止数据泄漏；Random Forest 和 EEGNet 表现最佳，SHAP 与 occlusion 分析共同指向 delta/theta 振荡和额中央区域。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把模型性能与具有生理意义的 EEG 解释结合起来，并通过 4 秒片段消融寻找稳健性折中，但仍属于回顾性模型研究，不能直接证明诊断临床效用。
items.abstract_zh: Rett syndrome（RTT）是一种罕见神经发育障碍，其异常皮层活动可通过脑电图（EEG）捕获。尽管机器学习（ML）已显示出诊断多种神经系统疾病的潜力，但针对 RTT 同时系统评估经典 ML 与深度学习（DL）方法，并提供具有生理意义的解释，仍较为有限。本研究使用 RTT 患者和健康对照的静息态、闭眼 EEG 记录，同时分析基于功率谱密度（PSD）的 ML 框架和端到端 DL 框架。经典 ML 模型包括在 PSD 特征上训练的 Support Vector Machines、Random Forest 和 XGBoost；EEG 专用 DL 架构包括直接在预处理 EEG 信号上训练的 ShallowConvNet、DeepConvNet、EEGNet 和 EEG Conformer。研究采用 subject-wise cross-validation 以避免数据泄漏，并以 balanced accuracy 作为主要性能指标，因为该指标对 sensitivity 和 specificity 给予同等权重。在经典 ML 模型中，Random Forest 表现最佳；在 DL 模型中，EEGNet 表现最佳。消融研究表明，4 秒 EEG 片段在模型性能和稳健性之间提供了最佳折中。研究使用 Random Forest 的 SHAP 和 EEGNet 的 occlusion sensitivity analysis 考察模型可解释性。两种方法一致识别出 delta 和 theta 振荡以及中央-额叶脑区是 RTT 分类的重要贡献因素。这些结果显示，基于 PSD 的机器学习和端到端深度学习均可可靠识别 RTT，并揭示共同的神经生理生物标志物，为 Rett syndrome 的 EEG 诊断和生物标志物发现提供了可解释框架。

items.title: IndoNutriQA: An Indonesian Clinical Nutrition Question Answering Benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical Question Answering (QA) underpins Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems, but progress is severely limited for low-resource languages such as Indonesian by the absence of public domain-specific data. We introduce IndoNutriQA, an expert-curated Indonesian clinical QA benchmark of 911 question-answer pairs built from real clinical-nutrition reports. Rather than a large-scale training corpus, it is positioned as a high-quality evaluation resource: every pair is grounded in a clinically relevant context, enriched with structured metadata (anthropometric assessment, medical diagnosis, document provenance, chunk segmentation). Eight standardised question types following the Nutrition Care Process (NCP), including the Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) diagnosis statement, are answered for every report, which was written by a graduate-level dietetic intern, by one of three nutritionists. Answers are free-form clinical prose rather than extractive spans, and an expert validation study finds 6-10% of reference answers contestable. The dataset supports generative, extractive and retrieval-augmented QA as well as zero- and few-shot LLM evaluation. We report fine-tuned baselines (IndoBERT variants, mT5, RAG) with 5-fold cross-validation, learning curves and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, and benchmark eight contemporary LLMs zero- and five-shot. We further calibrate our LLM-as-judge rubric against three expert raters (one RD, two nutritionists), finding it human-comparable on factuality and completeness but unreliable on clinical safety, and a human error analysis shows it misses unsupported content that the raters identify. IndoNutriQA is released to foster research in Indonesian clinical NLP and nutritional decision support.
items.summary_zh: 发布 IndoNutriQA：由专家整理、包含 911 对问答的印尼语临床营养 QA 基准，并报告 IndoBERT、mT5、RAG 及 8 个 LLM 的评估；LLM-as-judge 在临床安全性上不可靠。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该数据集填补低资源语言临床营养评测缺口，并明确显示自动评审可漏掉专家发现的不受支持内容，适合用于可复现的生成式、抽取式和 RAG 研究。
items.abstract_zh: 临床问答（QA）支撑临床智能决策支持系统，但对于印尼语等低资源语言，由于缺乏公开的领域数据，研究进展受到严重限制。我们提出 IndoNutriQA，这是一个由专家整理的印尼语临床问答基准，包含基于真实临床营养报告构建的 911 对问题-答案。它并非大规模训练语料，而是被定位为高质量评估资源：每一对问答都以临床相关情境为基础，并附有结构化元数据，包括人体测量评估、医学诊断、文档来源和分块分割。依据 Nutrition Care Process（NCP）制定的 8 种标准问题类型，包括 Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom（PES）诊断陈述；每份报告由研究生水平的营养学实习生撰写，再由 3 名营养师中的 1 名回答全部问题。答案是自由形式的临床 prose，而非抽取式片段；专家验证研究发现，参考答案中有 6–10% 存在可争议之处。该数据集支持生成式、抽取式和 retrieval-augmented QA，以及 zero-shot 和 few-shot LLM 评估。我们报告了 IndoBERT 变体、mT5 和 RAG 的微调基线，采用 5-fold cross-validation、学习曲线和 bootstrap 95% 置信区间；同时对 8 个当代 LLM 开展 zero-shot 和 five-shot 基准测试。我们进一步用 3 名专家评审者（1 名 RD、2 名营养师）校准 LLM-as-judge 评分标准，发现其在事实性和完整性方面与人工评审相当，但在临床安全性方面不可靠；人工错误分析显示，LLM-as-judge 会漏掉评审者识别出的不受支持内容。IndoNutriQA 已发布，以促进印尼语临床 NLP 和营养决策支持研究。

items.title: Comparative evaluation of large language models for guideline-based oral cancer management: a standardized assessment of GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, and Grok-3
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being investigated as tools for clinical information synthesis, patient education, and decision support. However, fluent language generation does not necessarily translate into clinically accurate or guideline-concordant recommendations. The extent to which contemporary LLMs can translate evidence-based oral cancer guidance into patient-accessible information and individualized clinical management remains insufficiently characterized. Methods We developed a standardized evaluation framework based on the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Head and Neck Cancers, Version 2.2025. GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, and Grok-3 were evaluated in two tasks: guideline summarization for non-medical audiences and case-based oral cancer management. Model outputs were assessed by three oral and maxillofacial surgeons across predefined dimensions, including accuracy, clarity, conciseness, logical coherence, diagnostic accuracy, treatment-regimen appropriateness, surgical planning, radiotherapy, systemic-status assessment, and prognosis. BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L were treated as exploratory text-similarity metrics. Results In the guideline-summary task, DeepSeek-R1 achieved the highest reported overall assessment score (8.8/10), followed by GPT-4o (8.3/10) and Grok-3 (7.8/10). DeepSeek-R1 also achieved the highest reported scores for accuracy (9.0), clarity (8.7), conciseness (8.7), and logic (9.2). In the case-based task, DeepSeek-R1 achieved the highest reported comprehensive score (87.44), followed by Grok-3 (77.77) and GPT-4o (68.61). DeepSeek-R1 achieved high reported scores for treatment-regimen accuracy (92), surgical-resection accuracy (93), radiotherapy-dose assessment (98), and prognosis (97). Grok-3 achieved the highest reported radiotherapy-dose score (100). The raw dataset also contains several anomalous values that require verification before inferential analysis, including a reported ROUGE-L value of 207 and several clinical scores of 20. Conclusions The three LLMs demonstrated distinct performance profiles rather than a uniformly superior model. DeepSeek-R1 showed the strongest descriptive overall performance in the current benchmark, particularly for structured treatment planning and prognostic assessment. However, clinically relevant variability was observed in staging, lymph-node management, surgical extent, HPV contextualization, and unsupported specificity. LLMs should therefore be considered assistive rather than autonomous clinical decision-support technologies. Larger multicentre studies using expert consensus standards and clinically meaningful endpoints are warranted.
items.summary_zh: 用 NCCN Head and Neck Cancers Version 2.2025 评估 GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1 和 Grok-3 的口腔癌指南总结与病例管理；DeepSeek-R1 描述性得分最高，但原始数据存在需核查的异常值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究显示 LLM 在分期、淋巴结管理、手术范围和 HPV 情境化方面仍有临床差异，支持将其定位为辅助工具而非自主决策系统。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被研究用于临床信息综合、患者教育和决策支持。然而，流畅的语言生成并不必然转化为临床准确或符合指南的建议。当代 LLM 能否将循证口腔癌指南转化为患者可理解的信息和个体化临床管理，目前仍缺乏充分刻画。方法：我们基于 National Comprehensive Cancer Network（NCCN）Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Head and Neck Cancers, Version 2.2025，建立标准化评估框架。GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1 和 Grok-3 接受两项任务评估：面向非医学受众的指南总结，以及基于病例的口腔癌管理。3 名口腔颌面外科医生按照预先规定的维度评估模型输出，包括准确性、清晰度、简洁性、逻辑连贯性、诊断准确性、治疗方案适宜性、手术规划、放疗、全身状态评估和预后。BLEU-4 和 ROUGE-L 被作为探索性文本相似度指标。结果：在指南总结任务中，DeepSeek-R1 获得最高的报告总体评估分数（8.8/10），其次为 GPT-4o（8.3/10）和 Grok-3（7.8/10）。DeepSeek-R1 在准确性（9.0）、清晰度（8.7）、简洁性（8.7）和逻辑性（9.2）方面也获得最高报告分数。在病例任务中，DeepSeek-R1 获得最高报告综合分数（87.44），其次为 Grok-3（77.77）和 GPT-4o（68.61）。DeepSeek-R1 在治疗方案准确性（92）、手术切除准确性（93）、放疗剂量评估（98）和预后（97）方面获得较高报告分数。Grok-3 获得最高的放疗剂量分数（100）。原始数据还包含若干需要在推断性分析前核验的异常值，包括一个报告的 ROUGE-L 值为 207，以及若干临床分数为 20。结论：3 个 LLM 展现出不同的性能谱，而不是某一模型在所有方面都优越。DeepSeek-R1 在当前基准中表现出最强的描述性总体性能，尤其是在结构化治疗规划和预后评估方面。然而，在分期、淋巴结管理、手术范围、HPV 情境化和无依据的具体化方面观察到具有临床意义的差异。因此，LLM 应被视为辅助性而非自主的临床决策支持技术。仍需采用专家共识标准和具有临床意义终点的更大规模多中心研究。

items.title: Neuro-Metabolic and Vascular Dysregulation are Functional Biomarkers of Acquired Brain Injury
creators: Chong Chie, J. A. K. H.
items.abstract_or_text: Emerging clinical and neuropathological evidence suggests a direct link between traumatic brain injury (TBI) and neurodegenerative diseases (ND), but the mechanisms by which TBI contributes to ND onset and progression remain unclear. To bridge this gap, the NINDS TBI-ADRD consortium developed a diagnostic framework to guide the design and evaluation of TBI-ADRD experiments using translational neuroimaging (DCE-MRI, 18F-FDG-PET) and advanced image-processing pipelines. Neuro-metabolic and vascular dysregulation (MVD) and metabolic functional connectomics (MFC) were evaluated in 8-month C57BL/6J mice at 30- and 60-days post-injury (DPI). Both MVD and MFC revealed significant changes at 30- and 60-DPI that were sex- and injury side-dependent. Female mice showed greater regional MVD alterations, while MFC identified sex-dependent changes at 30-DPI that diminished by 60-DPI. These findings suggest that a single mid-life closed-head injury induces sexually dimorphic MVD and brain network remodeling, supporting the potential of MVD as a sensitive biomarker for improved clinical monitoring post-TBI.
items.summary_zh: 在 C57BL/6J 小鼠创伤后 30 和 60 天用 DCE-MRI、18F-FDG-PET 与图像处理评估神经代谢和血管失调（MVD）及代谢功能连接组（MFC），发现变化具有性别和损伤侧依赖性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果支持 MVD 作为创伤性脑损伤后监测候选生物标志物，但研究为小鼠模型，不能把功能关联直接解释为人类 TBI 到神经退行性病变的因果机制。
items.abstract_zh: 新出现的临床和神经病理学证据提示，创伤性脑损伤（TBI）与神经退行性疾病（ND）之间存在直接联系，但 TBI 如何促成 ND 的发生和进展，其机制仍不清楚。为弥合这一缺口，NINDS TBI-ADRD 联盟建立了一个诊断框架，用于指导采用转化神经影像（DCE-MRI、18F-FDG-PET）和先进图像处理流程的 TBI-ADRD 实验设计与评估。在 8 月龄 C57BL/6J 小鼠中，于损伤后 30 天和 60 天（DPI）评估神经代谢和血管失调（MVD）以及代谢功能连接组（MFC）。MVD 和 MFC 在 30-DPI 和 60-DPI 均显示显著变化，且变化取决于性别和损伤侧。雌性小鼠表现出更大的区域性 MVD 改变，而 MFC 识别出的性别依赖性变化在 30-DPI 时存在，在 60-DPI 时减弱。这些发现提示，单次中年期闭合性头部损伤可诱导性别二态性的 MVD 和脑网络重塑，支持将 MVD 作为提高 TBI 后临床监测敏感性的潜在生物标志物。
items.author_line: Chong Chie, J. A. K. H., Persohn, S. A., Jullienne, A., Yan, J., Bright, M., Obenaus, A., Territo, P. R.

items.title: Development of a deep learning model for glomerulus detection and segmentation in kidney histopathology images
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Estimation of nephron number, an indicator of renal reserve, requires quantitative assessment of glomerular number and size in kidney biopsy specimens. We aimed to develop an automated system for quantitative measurement of glomerular areas from clinical kidney biopsy images, across diverse kidney diseases. Methods: We developed a two-stage deep learning system combining Faster R-CNN for glomerular detection in whole-slide images (WSIs) and DeepLabV3+ for segmentation. Of 114 kidney biopsies (228 WSIs), 104 were used for model development and 10 for independent final evaluation. Agreement was assessed using the F1-score for detection, the Dice coefficient for segmentation, and the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) for glomerular area measurement. Analysis was performed at 40x total magnification (2.331 m/pixel) and validated against 400x images. Results: In the independent evaluation set, the artificial intelligence (AI) model achieved a mean F1-score of 0.851 for detection, compared with 0.888 among experts. For segmentation, the Dice coefficient was 0.959 {+/-} 0.011 and the per-pair ICC (2,1) for area measurement was 0.989 {+/-} 0.009; both were comparable to inter-expert agreement. Bland-Altman analysis showed a mean bias of -344 m2 (95% limits of agreement, -1904 to 1216 m2) between 40x and 400x measurements. Conclusion: The two-stage model achieved glomerular segmentation and area measurement comparable to expert agreement in independent clinical data, with detection performance approaching inter-expert agreement, and provided reliable measurements at low magnification. This automated approach may facilitate large-scale quantitative kidney pathology and nephron number estimation from clinical kidney biopsies.
items.summary_zh: 两阶段 Faster R-CNN + DeepLabV3+ 系统在独立肾活检数据上完成肾小球检测、分割和面积测量，分割 Dice 0.959，面积 ICC 0.989，接近专家一致性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法在低倍率图像上提供可量化的肾小球测量，具有扩大肾脏病理和肾单位数量估计的潜力，但独立评估仅 10 例活检。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：肾单位数量是肾脏储备的指标，其估计需要对肾活检标本中的肾小球数量和大小进行定量评估。我们的目标是开发一个自动化系统，从不同肾脏疾病的临床肾活检图像中定量测量肾小球面积。方法：我们开发了一个两阶段深度学习系统，将 Faster R-CNN 用于全视野图像（WSI）中的肾小球检测，将 DeepLabV3+ 用于分割。114 例肾活检（228 张 WSI）中，104 例用于模型开发，10 例用于独立最终评估。研究使用 detection 的 F1-score、segmentation 的 Dice coefficient 以及肾小球面积测量的 intraclass correlation coefficient（ICC）评估一致性。分析在 40x 总放大倍数（2.331 m/pixel）下进行，并用 400x 图像验证。结果：在独立评估集上，人工智能（AI）模型的平均 detection F1-score 为 0.851，专家为 0.888。Segmentation Dice coefficient 为 0.959 ± 0.011，面积测量的 per-pair ICC (2,1) 为 0.989 ± 0.009；二者均与专家间一致性相当。Bland-Altman 分析显示，40x 与 400x 测量之间的平均偏倚为 -344 m2（95% 一致性界限，-1904 至 1216 m2）。结论：两阶段模型在独立临床数据上实现了与专家一致性相当的肾小球分割和面积测量，检测性能接近专家间一致性，并在低倍率下提供可靠测量。该自动化方法可能促进从临床肾活检开展大规模定量肾脏病理分析和肾单位数量估计。
items.author_line: Tosaki, T., Sasaki, T., Okabayashi, Y., Haruhara, K., Okabe, M., Tsuboi, N., Yokoo, T.

items.title: A Plasmodium falciparum Pangenome Resource to Drive Structural Variant Discovery and to assist Malaria Control
items.abstract_or_text: Plasmodium falciparum, the deadliest causative agent of malaria, harbours extensive structural variation that underlies key biological processes including drug resistance and diagnostic evasion. Here, we present PfPan, a P. falciparum pangenome constructed from 13 geographically diverse high-quality reference genomes using Minigraph-Cactus, adding 4.77 Mb of sequence beyond the 3D7 linear reference. We identify over 5,000 structural variants (SVs) across the reference genomes and demonstrate improved genotyping using the vg toolkit compared to linear reference-based approaches, with comparable performance for small variant discovery. Benchmarking against assembly-derived truth sets confirms pangenome superiority for structural variant detection, particularly at complex and hypervariable loci. Applying PfPan to 878 globally sampled P. falciparum whole-genome sequences, we characterise biologically and clinically relevant SVs, including the complex drug resistance-linked gch1 locus, and explore deletions upstream of the coding sequence for the diagnostic target HRP2. PfPan provides a foundational resource for mitigating reference bias in P. falciparum genomic surveillance and establishes a framework for improved detection of variants associated with drug resistance and malaria control in monoclonal P. falciparum samples that have not undergone selective whole-genome amplification.
items.summary_zh: 用 13 个地理多样的高质量参考基因组构建 PfPan，新增 4.77 Mb 序列并识别超过 5,000 个结构变异；在 878 个全球样本中解析耐药和诊断逃逸相关位点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该泛基因组降低线性参考偏倚，能更好检测复杂和高变异区域的结构变异，为疟疾基因组监测与耐药控制提供可复用资源。
items.abstract_zh: 恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium falciparum）是最致命的疟疾病原体，其广泛的结构变异支撑包括耐药和诊断逃逸在内的关键生物学过程。我们提出 PfPan，这是一个由 13 个地理来源多样的高质量参考基因组构建的 P. falciparum 泛基因组，使用 Minigraph-Cactus，并在 3D7 线性参考基因组之外增加了 4.77 Mb 序列。我们在这些参考基因组中识别出超过 5,000 个结构变异（SV），并使用 vg toolkit 证明，与基于线性参考的方法相比，PfPan 能改善基因分型，同时在小变异发现方面具有相当性能。与基于组装的真值集进行基准比较证实，泛基因组在结构变异检测方面更优，尤其是在复杂和高度可变位点。将 PfPan 应用于 878 个全球采样的 P. falciparum 全基因组序列后，我们刻画了具有生物学和临床相关性的结构变异，包括复杂的耐药相关 gch1 位点，并探索了诊断靶标 HRP2 编码序列上游的缺失。PfPan 为减轻 P. falciparum 基因组监测中的参考偏倚提供了基础资源，并为改进与耐药和疟疾控制相关变异的检测建立了框架；这些样本为未经过选择性全基因组扩增的单克隆 P. falciparum 样本。
items.author_line: Billows, N., Thorpe, J., Campino, S., Clark, T. G.

items.title: Limb-localized induction of regeneration reshapes brain and amputation-site transcriptional states in adult Xenopus laevis
items.abstract_or_text: Limb regeneration requires coordinated tissue reconstruction and nervous system reintegration, yet whether regenerative induction alters brain responses to limb loss remains unclear. We analyzed transcriptomics from the paired brains and amputation sites of adult Xenopus laevis after hindlimb amputation with or without a 24 hour exposure to localized, pro-regenerative multi-drug treatment (MDT) delivered through a wearable bioreactor device. At 24 hours post treatment (24 HPT), MDT brains showed increased vascular and basement membrane transcripts and enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation and mTORC1 programs. In the limb, an exploratory integrated stress response (ISR) score increased at 11 and 24 HPT and returned to control levels by 7 days post-treatment (7 DPT), coinciding with induction of growth differentiation factor 15 (GDF15), a cytokine responsive to mitochondrial stress. We detected no corresponding increase in brain ISR score. At 7 DPT, MDT brains showed enrichment of immune, heme metabolism and biosynthetic programs, reduced synaptic transmission gene expression, and increased gdf15.L. Relative to an external uninjured reference, MDT and amputation only brains showed concordant changes, with treatment modifying selected programs. Cross-species comparative analyses identified partial overlap with an axolotl regenerative glutamatergic signature and separation from selected mammalian injury profiles. These findings reveal cross-tissue responses to regenerative induction and identify candidate mechanisms of brain body communication in biomedically engineered vertebrate limb regeneration.
items.summary_zh: 在成年 Xenopus laevis 截肢模型中比较局部促再生多药处理与单纯截肢后的脑和截肢部位转录状态，发现跨组织反应及候选脑-体通信机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把再生诱导的局部处理与远端脑转录组联系起来，并用跨物种比较定位与 axolotl 再生信号及哺乳动物损伤谱的部分重叠；这些机制仍属候选解释。
items.abstract_zh: 肢体再生需要组织重建与神经系统重新整合的协调，但再生诱导是否会改变肢体丧失后的脑反应，仍不清楚。我们分析了成年 Xenopus laevis 后肢截肢后配对脑组织和截肢部位的转录组；动物接受或不接受通过可穿戴生物反应器装置递送的局部促再生多药治疗（MDT），治疗持续 24 小时。在治疗后 24 小时（24 HPT），MDT 组脑组织中血管和基底膜转录本增加，氧化磷酸化和 mTORC1 程序富集。在肢体中，探索性整合应激反应（ISR）评分在 11 和 24 HPT 升高，并在治疗后 7 天（7 DPT）恢复到对照水平；这一变化与生长分化因子 15（GDF15）的诱导相吻合，GDF15 是一种对线粒体应激有反应的细胞因子。我们没有检测到脑 ISR 评分相应升高。在 7 DPT，MDT 组脑组织中免疫、血红素代谢和生物合成程序富集，突触传递基因表达降低，gdf15.L 增加。相对于外部未损伤参考，MDT 组和仅截肢组脑组织显示一致性变化，而治疗改变了部分特定程序。跨物种比较分析发现，其与蝾螈再生性谷氨酸能信号存在部分重叠，并与选定的哺乳动物损伤谱相分离。这些发现揭示了再生诱导后的跨组织反应，并确定了生物医学工程脊椎动物肢体再生中脑-身体通信的候选机制。
items.author_line: Murugan, N. J., Russell, S., Kaplan, D., Levin, M., Miller, K.

items.title: Functional Validation of Known BEST1 Variants Using a Robust Halide-Sensitive YFP Quenching Assay
items.abstract_or_text: Bestrophinopathies comprise a heterogeneous group of inherited retinal degenerative diseases caused by mutations in the Bestrophin-1 (BEST1) gene. Although more than 250 pathogenic BEST1 variants have been reported, only a small subset has undergone functional interrogation. OPGx-BEST1 is an investigational gene therapy designed to restore BEST1 function through augmented wild-type BEST1 expression in retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) cells. Previous studies in animal models and patient-derived cellular systems have demonstrated that loss-of-function (LOF) BEST1 variants can be complemented with wild-type protein expression and are therefore amenable to gene augmentation strategies. In contrast, known gain-of-function (GOF) mutations appear to retain pathogenic activity despite augmentation with wild-type BEST1. Therefore, given the therapeutic relevance of LOF/GOF disease mechanisms in bestrophinopathies, a comprehensive genotype-phenotype characterization across the BEST1 mutational landscape is critical to inform clinical trial enrollment. Conventional approaches to profile BEST1 variants have relied upon patient-derived RPE models and electrophysiologic assessment of channel function. While these systems provide valuable translational insight, they lack the scalability, speed, and experimental flexibility needed for a systematic evaluation of many variants for patient selection. Here, we describe a functional screening platform that leverages an engineered halide-sensitive reporter cell line to quantitatively assess the activity of BEST1 mutant proteins.
items.summary_zh: 介绍基于工程化卤化物敏感报告细胞系的 BEST1 突变功能筛选平台，用于扩展 bestrophinopathies 的 LOF/GOF 基因型-表型评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 平台针对患者筛选所需的规模、速度和实验灵活性改进传统 RPE/电生理方法，但摘要尚未给出具体变体筛选结果或临床疗效证据。
items.abstract_zh: Bestrophinopathies 是一组异质性遗传性视网膜变性疾病，由 Bestrophin-1（BEST1）基因突变引起。尽管已有超过 250 个致病性 BEST1 变体被报道，但只有少数接受过功能研究。OPGx-BEST1 是一种研究性基因治疗，旨在通过增强视网膜色素上皮（RPE）细胞中的野生型 BEST1 表达来恢复 BEST1 功能。既往动物模型和患者来源细胞系统研究表明，功能缺失（LOF）BEST1 变体可以通过表达野生型蛋白得到补偿，因此适合基因增补策略。相反，已知的功能获得（GOF）突变在补充野生型 BEST1 后似乎仍保留致病活性。因此，鉴于 LOF/GOF 疾病机制与 bestrophinopathies 治疗相关，对 BEST1 突变谱开展全面的基因型-表型表征，对于指导临床试验入组至关重要。以往用于分析 BEST1 变体的方法依赖患者来源的 RPE 模型和通道功能电生理评估。虽然这些系统提供了有价值的转化洞见，但它们缺乏对大量变体进行系统评估所需的规模、速度和实验灵活性。在这里，我们描述了一个功能筛选平台，该平台利用工程化卤化物敏感报告细胞系，对 BEST1 突变蛋白的活性进行定量评估。
items.author_line: Siriwardena, S. U., Choudhary, M., Lee, J., Yerxa, B. R., Tucker, S., Magrath, G., McDougald, D. S., Tipper, C. H., Jayagopal, A.

items.title: Antibacterial, antibiofilm, modulatory effects, pharmacokinetic profile, toxicity and molecular docking of Monarda fistulosa essential oil against Multidrug-Resistant Acinetobacter baumannii
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract The increasing spread of multidrug-resistant (MDR) Acinetobacter baumannii strains and their high biofilm-forming capacity represent a serious global public health challenge, limiting therapeutic options. Given this scenario, the aim of this study was to evaluate the chemical composition, antibacterial and antibiofilm activity, modulatory effect in combination with carbapenems and ciprofloxacin, and in silico interaction mechanisms of Monarda fistulosa essential oil (MFEO) against nosocomial isolates of MDR A. baumannii , as well as to predict pharmacokinetic and toxicity characteristics. Phytochemical characterization via Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) identified the monoterpene geraniol (92.3%) as the major constituent. Broth microdilution assays demonstrated significant antibacterial activity of MFEO, with Minimum Inhibitory Concentrations (MIC) ranging from 312 to 625 µg/mL and a bactericidal profile against all tested strains. In the synergism evaluation using the checkerboard method, MFEO exhibited an additive effect with meropenem and imipenem, reducing the carbapenem dosage required to inhibit bacterial growth in the most resistant strains, although it showed an indifferent interaction with ciprofloxacin. Furthermore, MFEO demonstrated strong dose-dependent inhibition during the initial cell adhesion phase and promoted significant eradication of pre-formed mature biofilms, outperforming meropenem control treatments at MIC, 2xMIC, and 4xMIC concentrations. In silico analyses indicated favorable pharmacokinetic profiles and low toxicity for the MFEO compounds, while molecular docking revealed moderate binding affinity of the compounds to the catalytic residues of OXA-24 and to the outer membrane protein A (OmpA). Taken together, these results demonstrate the potential of MFEO as a phytotherapeutic agent and as a promising adjuvant in combating severe infections caused by MDR A. baumannii .
items.summary_zh: 评估 Monarda fistulosa essential oil（MFEO）对 MDR Acinetobacter baumannii 的抗菌、抗生物膜、药物联用、药代和毒性特征；geraniol 占 92.3%，并与 OXA-24、OmpA 进行分子对接。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究结合体外菌株实验、联合用药和结构建模，提示 MFEO 可能作为辅助治疗，但 MIC 较高、对接并不等于体内疗效，仍需药理和临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 多重耐药 Acinetobacter baumannii 菌株及其较强的生物膜形成能力日益扩散，构成严重的全球公共卫生挑战，限制了治疗选择。在这一背景下，本研究旨在评估 Monarda fistulosa essential oil（MFEO）对医院来源 MDR A. baumannii 分离株的化学组成、抗菌和抗生物膜活性、与 carbapenems 和 ciprofloxacin 联用时的调节作用，以及其计算机模拟相互作用机制，同时预测药代动力学和毒性特征。通过 Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry（GC-MS）进行植物化学表征，发现单萜 geraniol 是主要成分，占 92.3%。肉汤微量稀释试验显示，MFEO 具有显著抗菌活性，Minimum Inhibitory Concentrations（MIC）范围为 312–625 μg/mL，并对所有测试菌株呈现杀菌特征。在使用棋盘法开展的协同作用评估中，MFEO 与 meropenem 和 imipenem 呈加和效应，降低了抑制最耐药菌株生长所需的 carbapenem 剂量，但与 ciprofloxacin 的相互作用为无关。此外，MFEO 在初始细胞黏附阶段表现出强烈的剂量依赖性抑制作用，并在 MIC、2xMIC 和 4xMIC 浓度下显著清除已形成的成熟生物膜，效果优于 meropenem 对照处理。计算机模拟分析表明，MFEO 化合物具有有利的药代动力学特征和低毒性；分子对接显示，这些化合物与 OXA-24 催化残基及外膜蛋白 A（OmpA）具有中等结合亲和力。总体而言，这些结果显示 MFEO 具有作为植物治疗剂以及对抗 MDR A. baumannii 严重感染的潜在辅助剂的可能性。
items.author_line: Martins MDLT, Rodrigues PHL, Aguiar FLL, Gomes GA, Fontenelle ROS, Barbosa FCB

items.title: GeoSinkhorn Flow: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for Perturbation-Conditioned Dynamics in Single cell Data Phenoscapes
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell technologies increasingly enable large-scale profiling of complex biological systems across many experimental perturbations, but understanding how a system reorganizes across an entire space of conditions is difficult to interpret from single-cell embeddings alone. Phenoscapes address this by embedding entire cell-state distributions, rather than individual cells, as points in a data-driven landscape. Thus, a single dot represents one experimental condition rather than one cell, yielding a map of the perturbation or patient landscape that reveals how phenotype varies continuously across conditions. Phenoscapes remain a comparatively new and underexplored representation and existing static phenoscapes position experimental conditions relative to one another without specifying trajectories that describe how a cellular population moves from one condition to another. Flow- and trajectory-based models for single-cell data are numerous, but existing approaches operate at the level of individual cells, are not built to respect the geometry of a phenoscape, and typically cannot generalize their predicted flows to conditions not seen during training. Here we introduce GeoSinkhorn Flow, a perturbation-conditioned, geometry-aware flow-matching framework specialized designed to convert a static phenoscape into a dynamic phenoscape, in which each condition-level point is additionally connected by geodesic, condition-aware transport trajectories that are consistent with the phenoscape's underlying geometry. GeoSinkhorn Flow can also model transitions directly between time points without constructing a phenoscape. GeoSinkhorn Flow uses heat-diffusion geometry to define manifold-aware transport costs and trains a geometric autoencoder whose latent Euclidean distances stay aligned with the static phenoscape geometry while extending it to unseen cells. By explicitly conditioning the learned transport dynamics on perturbation-specific gene or drug embeddings, GeoSinkhorn Flow generalizes its trajectories to new measurement conditions, produces intermediate progression states along a trajectory, and extends predictions to unseen cells and held-out perturbations. An unbalanced optimal transport variant further learns growth or transition weights, so that changes in relative cell-state abundance or transition propensity are modeled together with state movement. Across synthetic manifolds, patient-derived organoid drug responses, Perturb-seq knockdowns, and time-resolved CyTOF signaling, GeoSinkhorn Flow recovered intrinsic manifold geometry, inferred biologically coherent response trajectories, and generalized to held-out drug combinations, perturbation genes, and time points. Together, these results establish GeoSinkhorn Flow as a perturbation-conditioned, phenoscape-consistent dynamical framework, distinct from standard flow-matching approaches, for converting static phenoscapes into dynamic ones that generalize across experimental conditions.
items.summary_zh: 提出 GeoSinkhorn Flow，将单细胞条件分布的静态 phenoscape 转为带有几何一致性、扰动条件化运输轨迹的动态 phenoscape，并在多种合成、类器官、Perturb-seq 和 CyTOF 数据上泛化到留出条件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法在条件分布层面建模细胞状态迁移，而非只追踪单细胞，兼顾流形几何、未见扰动和细胞丰度变化，适合大规模扰动响应分析。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞技术越来越能够对复杂生物系统在多种实验扰动下进行大规模分析，但仅从单细胞嵌入理解系统如何在整个条件空间中重组仍然困难。Phenoscape 通过将完整的细胞状态分布而非单个细胞嵌入数据驱动的景观，把每个实验条件表示为一个点。因此，一个点代表一个实验条件而不是一个细胞，从而形成扰动或患者景观图，揭示表型如何在条件之间连续变化。Phenoscape 仍是相对较新且尚未充分探索的表示方式；现有静态 phenoscape 只将实验条件彼此定位，并未指定描述细胞群体如何从一个条件移动到另一个条件的轨迹。单细胞数据的流模型和轨迹模型很多，但现有方法在单细胞层面运行，不适于保持 phenoscape 的几何结构，且通常无法将预测流泛化到训练中未见的条件。我们提出 GeoSinkhorn Flow，这是一种扰动条件化、几何感知的流匹配框架，专门用于将静态 phenoscape 转换为动态 phenoscape；在动态 phenoscape 中，每个条件点还通过与条件相关、符合 phenoscape 潜在几何结构的测地线运输轨迹相连。GeoSinkhorn Flow 也可以直接建模时间点之间的转换，而无需构建 phenoscape。GeoSinkhorn Flow 使用热扩散几何定义流形感知的运输成本，并训练一个几何自编码器，使潜在欧氏距离与静态 phenoscape 几何保持一致，同时扩展到未见细胞。通过显式地将学习到的运输动力学与扰动特异的基因或药物嵌入进行条件化，GeoSinkhorn Flow 可将轨迹泛化到新的测量条件，生成轨迹中的中间进展状态，并将预测扩展到未见细胞和留出扰动。一个非平衡最优运输变体进一步学习生长或转换权重，从而同时建模细胞状态相对丰度或转换倾向的变化。在合成流形、患者来源类器官药物反应、Perturb-seq 敲低和时间分辨 CyTOF 信号等数据上，GeoSinkhorn Flow 恢复了内在流形几何，推断出具有生物学一致性的反应轨迹，并泛化到留出的药物组合、扰动基因和时间点。总体而言，GeoSinkhorn Flow 建立了一个扰动条件化且与 phenoscape 一致的动力学框架，将静态 phenoscape 转换为可跨实验条件泛化的动态 phenoscape；它不同于标准流匹配方法。
